title: Danggui Buxue Decoction inhibits pulmonary fibrosis by alleviating TGF-beta1-induced proliferation and apoptosis in EBL cells via PI3K/AKT/FOXO1 pathway.
authors: Yang, Zhuo; Ji, Peng; Zhang, Wenfei; Li, Chenchen; Wu, Fanlin; Hua, Yongli; Wei, Yanming; Cao, Yuxia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究当归补血汤通过PI3K/AKT/FOXO1通路抑制肺纤维化，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Pulmonary fibrosis (PF), a major fatal complication of calf pneumonia, is classified in traditional Chinese medicine as qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome. The classic formula Danggui Buxue Decoction (DBD) effectively treats PF by replenishing qi and blood and promoting circulation, though its precise mechanism remains unclear. AIMS: To elucidate DBD's anti-PF mechanism via apoptosis regulation using network pharmacology and in vitro studies. METHODS: HPLC was employed to analyze the active components of DBD. Network pharmacology identified core targets and pathways. Subsequently, a TGF-beta1-induced embryonic bovine lung (EBL) cells model was established, including the control, TGF-beta1, and DBD treatment groups (50, 250, and 500 mug/mL). DBD's effects were evaluated through proliferation, apoptosis, and migration (scratch) assays. Key targets were validated via Western blot, qRT-PCR, and immunofluorescence. RESULTS: Five active compounds in DBD were identified by HPLC. Sixty-seven PF-related targets, with EGFR, CASP3, Bcl-2, Bax, TNF, IL6, IL-1beta, HIF-1alpha, and AKT1 as core targets, were revealed by Network pharmacology. The PI3K/AKT, FOXO1, and apoptosis signaling pathways are the major pathways. Molecular docking demonstrated strong binding between DBD compounds (calycosin-7-glucoside, chlorogenic acid, ferulic acid, formononetin, ononin) and AKT1/Bax/Bcl-2. Therefore, the PI3K/AKT, FOXO, and apoptosis pathways were proposed as potential therapeutic targets for subsequent experimental validation. In vitro studies demonstrated that DBD promotes apoptosis through PI3K/AKT pathway inhibition, as shown by the downregulation of alpha-SMA, P-PI3K, P-AKT, P-FOXO1, and Bax, along with the upregulation of Bcl-2 and E-cad. CONCLUSION: DBD alleviates PF by inhibiting PI3K/AKT/FOXO1-mediated apoptosis, supporting its therapeutic potential.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：肺纤维化（PF）是犊牛肺炎的一种主要致命并发症，在中医中归类为气滞血瘀证。经典方剂当归补血汤（DBD）通过补气养血、促进循环有效治疗PF，但其确切机制尚不清楚。目的：通过网络药理学和体外研究，阐明DBD通过凋亡调控发挥抗PF作用的机制。方法：采用高效液相色谱法（HPLC）分析DBD的活性成分。网络药理学确定核心靶点和通路。随后，建立TGF-β1诱导的胚胎牛肺（EBL）细胞模型，包括对照组、TGF-β1组和DBD处理组（50、250和500 μg/mL）。通过增殖、凋亡和迁移（划痕）实验评估DBD的作用。通过Western blot、qRT-PCR和免疫荧光验证关键靶点。结果：HPLC鉴定出DBD中的五种活性化合物。网络药理学揭示67个PF相关靶点，其中EGFR、CASP3、Bcl-2、Bax、TNF、IL6、IL-1β、HIF-1α和AKT1为核心靶点。PI3K/AKT、FOXO1和凋亡信号通路是主要通路。分子对接显示DBD化合物（毛蕊异黄酮-7-葡萄糖苷、绿原酸、阿魏酸、芒柄花素、芒柄花苷）与AKT1/Bax/Bcl-2之间具有强结合力。因此，提出PI3K/AKT、FOXO和凋亡通路作为后续实验验证的潜在治疗靶点。体外研究表明，DBD通过抑制PI3K/AKT通路促进凋亡，表现为α-SMA、P-PI3K、P-AKT、P-FOXO1和Bax的下调，以及Bcl-2和E-cad的上调。结论：DBD通过抑制PI3K/AKT/FOXO1介导的凋亡缓解PF，支持其治疗潜力。
